sections.bio:
I write about anything and everything for a living. 
 
And my only goal is to make content simple enough so everyone understands it.

Because let's admit. Industry jargon and literature essays don't close deals.

Understanding your buyer does.
 
Tech, B2B, AI, industry jargon. I've written about all of it. 
 
I love to think about reasons why people stop scrolling and I've spent 3 years reverse engineering that. 

Now I work with founders who have something real to say but it somehow always comes out flat on paper. 

Who've built something good but their content sounds like everyone else's. 

I find your voice, build a presence that's actually yours, and write in a way that earns attention without screaming for it.

Posts, brand narratives, ghostwriting, lead magnets..

different format, same question: why would someone stop for this?
 
DM me.
 
Let's bring the authenticity back. 🙂‍↔️
